created: Done, we registered the system. Now let's check the connection.
activated: Done, automatic evaluation is now active.
scheduled: Done, we scheduled the automatic evaluation.
connection_failed: We couldn't connect to the system. Check the details and try again.
not_validated: Check the connection first so you can activate it.
not_active: Activate the connection first so you can schedule it.
connection_set: We saved the role. Now let us check the connection.
updated: We saved the changes. If the connection changed, it needs to be checked again.
removed: We removed the system. Its history is kept.
resources: These are the assets we found in your account.
